items.title: Jalen Wilson, RayJ Dennis, and Keshon Gilbert are officially listed as questionable with the G League distinction.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
Jalen Wilson, RayJ Dennis, and Keshon Gilbert are officially listed as questionable with the G League distinction.

(The Hawks can't have all 3 of them active anyway because that would put them at 16.)

quote.author: Brad Rowland
quote.text:
First official Hawks injury report of the season ahead of Wednesday’s opener in Orlando:

Mouhamed Gueye (left foot fracture) is out.

Henri Veesaar (torn right ACL) is out.

items.title: I think Jalen Wilson has played well for the Hawks in the preseason.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
I think Jalen Wilson has played well for the Hawks in the preseason.

Continue to think that was an excellent two-way signing.
